newsitem.title: JAPAN: Earthquake strikes isles south of Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake strikes isles south of Tokyo.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale struck near a small island 600 km (370 miles) southwest of Tokyo early on Thursday morning and caused minor tsunami tidal waves, Japan's Meteorological Agency said.
There were no reports of casualties or damage.
The tremor, which struck around 3.15 a.m. (1815 GMT Wednesday) with its epicentre near Torishima Island, was felt in parts of the Tokyo area, the agency said.
A warning of tsunami tidal waves was lifted at 5.34 a.m. (2034 GMT), about two hours after it was issued.

Several small tidal waves were registered at Hachijojima, Izuoshima, and Miyakejima, three islands in the cluster of Pacific islands south of Tokyo which experience hundreds of minor earthquakes each year, the agency said.
